title: Owner growth
description: Acquisition, product output and search reach for Harbour. Each number keeps its unit, source and missing-data policy.

kpis.label: Monthly recurring revenue
kpis.help: Invoice-backed recurring revenue. Not an annualised estimate.

kpis.label: Active accounts
kpis.help: Signed in, created a report or recorded activity in the last 30 days.

kpis.label: New accounts · 30d
kpis.help: A rolling count, not today's signups.

kpis.label: Trial to paid · 30d
kpis.help: Mature trials only. Recent cohorts are excluded.

sections.title: Acquisition
sections.caption: A rolling 30-day count and an active base. These populations are not the same as signups or paying customers.

panels.title: New accounts · 30d
panels.subtitle: A rolling count; missing dates stay blank.

panels.title: Plan mix
panels.subtitle: Current paid accounts by plan.
panels.note: Plan mix is a fixed workshop value, not a measured metric in this starter.

sections.title: Product output
sections.caption: Completed reports and the operational measures around them. Reports are not customers.

panels.title: Reports generated
panels.subtitle: Cumulative completed reports. A counter may step down only after a reset or correction.

panels.title: This month
panels.note: The rows are a compact readout; the metric catalog remains the definition.

sections.title: Search reach
sections.caption: Impressions and clicks are search totals. They are not visitors, accounts or attributed customers.

panels.title: Click-through rate
panels.subtitle: Clicks divided by impressions for the same day.

note: Starter data is fictional. Replace the snapshot with measured rows and keep the definitions in metrics/*.json.
